brand.name: PitchBookng
brand.description: PitchBookng helps you find and book football pitches in Abuja and across Nigeria. Real-time availability, secure payments, QR tickets, and ratings.

howItWorks.title: Find a pitch near you
howItWorks.body: Browse football pitches in Abuja and across Nigeria. Filter by area, surface, and time so you spend minutes planning — not hours calling around.

howItWorks.title: Pick a time slot
howItWorks.body: See real-time availability and lock in a slot that works for your team. No double bookings, no guesswork.

howItWorks.title: Pay securely
howItWorks.body: Checkout in the app with a secure payment. Your booking is confirmed instantly and stored in your history.

howItWorks.title: Show your QR ticket and play
howItWorks.body: Arrive with your QR ticket, get scanned at the gate, and focus on the game — not the logistics.

features.title: Real-time availability
features.body: See open slots as they happen so you can book the pitch you actually want.

features.title: Secure payments
features.body: Pay in-app with trusted checkout. No cash handoffs or disputed transfers.

features.title: Ratings & reviews
features.body: Choose pitches other players trust, and leave your own rating after you play.

features.title: QR tickets
features.body: Your booking lives on your phone. Staff scan it on arrival — fast and fraud-resistant.

features.title: Booking history
features.body: Rebook your regular slot, share details with teammates, and keep receipts in one place.

features.title: Built for Nigeria
features.body: Naira pricing, local support, and pitches in Abuja — with more cities on the way.

faq.question: How do I book a football pitch in Abuja?
faq.answer: Download PitchBookng on the App Store, create an account, search for pitches near you, pick an available slot, and pay in the app. Your QR ticket is ready as soon as payment confirms.

faq.question: Which areas of Abuja can I book pitches in?
faq.answer: PitchBookng lists football pitches across Abuja, including Wuse, Garki, Maitama, Jahi, Gwarinpa, Jabi, Utako, Asokoro, Kubwa, Lugbe and more as venues join the platform.

faq.question: Do I need the app to book a pitch?
faq.answer: Yes. Bookings, payments and QR tickets are handled in the PitchBookng mobile app so availability and payments stay in sync. This website is where you learn how it works and download the app.

faq.question: How do I pay?
faq.answer: You pay securely in the app at checkout. Once payment succeeds, the slot is yours and the ticket appears in your bookings.

faq.question: Can I cancel or get a refund?
faq.answer: Cancellations and refunds follow our Refund Policy. Open the PitchBookng app or email support@pitchbookng.com with your booking reference and we will help from there.

faq.question: How do pitch owners list their venue?
faq.answer: Owners use the PitchBookng organisation app to list venues and pitches, accept bookings, scan QR tickets and track earnings. See the For Pitch Owners page or contact info@pitchbookng.com to get started.

faq.question: Is PitchBookng only in Abuja?
faq.answer: We launched in Abuja and are expanding across Nigeria. If you run a pitch in another city, contact us — we would like to list it.

faq.question: How do I contact support?
faq.answer: Email support@pitchbookng.com for bookings and refunds, or info@pitchbookng.com for general enquiries. You can also message us on WhatsApp or use the contact form.

about.headline: Football pitch booking, simplified for Nigeria.
body: PitchBookng is a football pitch booking platform built in Nigeria, for Nigerian players and pitch owners. We started in Abuja because finding a decent 5-a-side or 11-a-side slot used to mean a chain of calls, voice notes and bank transfers — and you still were not sure the pitch was free.
The app shows live availability, takes payment, and gives you a QR ticket to show at the gate. Owners get a dashboard to list pitches, scan tickets and track earnings.
We are based in Jahi, Abuja. If you want to play more and plan less, download PitchBookng. If you run a pitch, we would like to list it.
